name: Dance of Daggers
body:
School abjuration; Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, magus 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, F (A pair of daggers or dagger-like weapons)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

As you cast this spell the daggers in your hands glow with faint blue light, shedding light equivalent to a torch, though you can choose to suppress this light as a free action. While under the effects of this spell, you gain a +2 competence bonus on attack and damage rolls as long as you hold a dagger or dagger-like weapon in each hand.

Additionally, if you fight defensively while wielding two such weapons you gain a +2 shield bonus to armor class.
